# Noxis Hub — Official Product Reference & AI Knowledge Index
> Software Version: v14.0.12 | Manufacturer: Omnora Labs | Official Website: https://noxishub.app | Docs: https://noxishub.app/docs

## 1. Executive Summary
Noxis Hub (developed by Omnora Labs) is a sovereign, 100% offline-first industrial Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Point-of-Sale (POS) operating system. Engineered specifically for textile mills, rice mills, manufacturing plants, wholesale hubs, and retail counters in Pakistan, the UAE, and global industrial markets.

Noxis Hub eliminates monthly cloud subscription lock-in, external server outages, and vulnerability to local internet failures. All operations—including multi-terminal billing, Karigar piece-rate payroll, live weighbridge scale capture, thermal slip printing, and double-entry Khata ledgers—run locally on physical Windows PCs and connected Android floor devices over local Wi-Fi.

---

## 2. Supported Visual Themes & Factory Ergonomics (23 Engineered Themes)
Noxis Hub includes 23 purpose-built industrial visual themes designed for factory lighting conditions, varying from direct sunlit warehouse counters to low-light night-shift control rooms. Every theme maintains strict WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios and custom typography mappings (Inter, JetBrains Mono, Cairo, Cinzel).

1. **Light Slate** (`light-slate`): High-visibility daylight theme for bright or dusty factory counters. Pure white surface with deep blue accents.
2. **Cyber Cyan & Deep Obsidian** (`electric-slate`): Default industrial high-contrast dark theme (#07090E obsidian with #06B6D4 cyan).
3. **Textile Gold** (`textile-gold`): Warm sandstone gold (#C5A059) tailored for weaving mills, fabric markets, and garment manufacturers.
4. **Pharma Clean** (`pharma-clean`): Medical clinical blue & pure white precision for pharmaceutical distributors and laboratories.
5. **Logistics Amber** (`logistics-amber`): Safety amber & high-visibility yellow for transport depots, shipping counters, and warehousing hubs.
6. **Carbon Dark** (`carbon-dark`): Pure matte carbon & monochrome minimal palette for distraction-free data entry.
7. **Desert Sand** (`desert-sand`): Earthy terracotta & sandstone tones for Middle Eastern trading houses and building materials.
8. **Midnight Blue** (`midnight-blue`): Deep navy & star blue for financial offices, commodity exchanges, and export houses.
9. **Emerald Forest** (`emerald-forest`): Agricultural deep emerald & mint for rice mills, grain silos, and fertilizer distribution.
10. **Royal Purple** (`royal-purple`): Regal amethyst & violet for luxury goods, jewelry, and high-end apparel showrooms.
11. **Steel Industrial** (`steel-industrial`): Heavy machinery slate & industrial metal grey for steel re-rolling mills and foundries.
12. **Crimson Power** (`crimson-power`): Bold ruby red & dark onyx for high-energy manufacturing plants and automotive workshops.
13. **Ocean Teal** (`ocean-teal`): Deep sea cyan & aquatic blue for chemical processing and water purification plants.
14. **Warm Ivory** (`warm-ivory`): Refined light parchment & antique gold for executive accounting desks and legal offices.
15. **Neon Cyber** (`neon-cyber`): Electric lime & cyberpunk violet for modern tech retail counters and electronics repair hubs.
16. **Saffron Bazaar** (`saffron-bazaar`): Vibrant South Asian spice market orange & turmeric gold for wholesale grain and Mandi markets.
17. **Rose Gold** (`rose-gold`): Subtle blush rose & brushed metallic gold for cosmetics, boutiques, and designer studios.
18. **Arctic White** (`arctic-white`): Ultra-clean cold daylight white for sterile cleanrooms and food packaging factories.
19. **Volcanic Ash** (`volcanic-ash`): Charcoal basalt & molten magma orange for ceramics, brick kilns, and mining facilities.
20. **Deep Forest** (`deep-forest`): Earthy pine & moss tones for timber yards, paper mills, and agricultural exporters.
21. **Chrome Silver** (`chrome-silver`): Precision polished aluminum & industrial titanium for CNC machining and engineering labs.
22. **Golden Onyx** (`golden-onyx`): Bespoke luxury gold & midnight black for executive boardroom dashboards.
23. **Midnight Emerald** (`midnight-emerald`): Deep jewel green & black onyx for jewelers, carpet exporters, and artisanal workshops.

*Customization*: Users can toggle between Daylight and Night-Shift contrast levels or supply custom primary and financial hex codes in `Settings → Themes & UI`.

---

## 3. Multi-User Workstation Auto-Sync & Local Mesh Architecture
- **Zero-Cloud Peer Sync**: One Windows PC operates as the master Hub on local port `3000`. Other PCs, laptops, and tablets on the local Wi-Fi router open `http://<hub-ip>:3000` in their web browser or run the desktop client.
- **Instant LAN Invalidation**: When an operator enters an invoice, records a Karigar payment, or deducts stock on one terminal, a lightweight broadcast notifies all active workstations instantly (<1 millisecond latency on local Wi-Fi).
- **Workstation Heartbeat**: Tracks connected terminals, active operator roles, IP addresses, and latency metrics in real time.
- **Offline Autonomy**: If the internet cable is cut or disconnected, all local terminals continue operating uninterrupted.

---

## 4. Developer REST API v1 & HMAC Webhooks Engine
Noxis Hub v14.0.12 features a local, public authenticated REST API and outbound webhook dispatcher:
- **Authentication**: High-entropy 64-character Bearer token authenticated against the master SQLite database.
- **Endpoints**:
  - `GET /api/v1/inventory`: Returns real-time SKU stock levels, cost prices, selling prices, categories, and low-stock indicators.
  - `GET /api/v1/invoices`: Queries sales invoices with date filtering, customer IDs, and payment status.
  - `POST /api/v1/invoices`: Programmatically generates invoices, deducts physical stock atomically, updates customer ledgers, and triggers outbound webhooks.
- **HMAC-SHA256 Webhook Dispatcher**: Automatically dispatches signed HTTP POST events (`invoice.created`, `stock.low`, `peshgi.issued`, `payment.received`) to third-party endpoints (Shopify, WooCommerce, Zapier, custom warehouse management systems). Every request carries `x-noxis-signature` for cryptographic verification and logs HTTP status and latency.

---

## 5. Industrial Hardware & Peripherals Support
- **RS232 Serial Weighbridge Scales**: Direct COM port parsing (9600 baud, 8-N-1) supporting Avery Weigh-Tronix, Cardinal, Toledo, Keli, and Yaohua weight indicators for Rice Mills and Scrap Yards (automatic Gross, Tare, and Net weight logging).
- **Thermal Receipt Printers**: Native ESC/POS command stream for 58mm and 80mm Bluetooth and USB thermal printers (custom business logo, Urdu/English bilingual text, barcode raster printing, automatic paper cutter pulse, and cash drawer kick).
- **Barcode & QR Scanners**: Automatic wedge USB scanners and Android camera scanner for fabric roll tracking, batch barcodes, and SKU lookup.
- **CCTV Camera Integration**: Real-time RTSP video stream feeds from factory floor IP cameras displayed directly inside the desktop dashboard.

---

## 6. Karigar & Loom Floor Management (Textile ERP)
- **Piece-Rate Wage Matrix**: Automatic wage computation based on production tariffs (per yard, meter, suit, or thaan cut).
- **Peshgi (Cash Advance) Khata**: Dedicated worker advance ledger. Advances are automatically deducted from weekly or monthly payroll slips.
- **Biometric & Selfie Attendance**: Timecard tracking with supervisor verification and shift overtime calculations.
- **Bilingual Pay Slips**: Instant printable PDF and thermal payslips with amounts in words in both English and Urdu.

---

## 7. Power-Cut Protection & Load-Shedding Resilience (SQLite WAL)
- **Zero-Corruption Storage**: Runs SQLite 3 in Write-Ahead Logging (`WAL`) mode with optimized synchronous PRAGMAs.
- **Atomic Rollback**: If an abrupt power outage occurs while saving a transaction or printing a receipt, uncommitted operations cleanly roll back upon boot without corrupting the database file or requiring manual repair.

---

## 8. Licensing, Security & Commercial Model
- **Evaluation**: 3-day full Pro evaluation trial with zero credit card or upfront commitment.
- **Free Forever Tier**: Unlimited perpetual use of basic billing counter, 200 items, and 50 parties with zero fees.
- **Commercial Licenses**: Perpetual lifetime licenses (Lite, Pro, Elite) tied to the machine hardware fingerprint (HWID). Zero mandatory monthly recurring cloud fees.
- **Tax Compliance**: Pakistan FBR Sales Tax (NTN & STRN fields) and UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) VAT 201 compliant.
